name: Ovex FurCut Cargo Short
description: A wide-leg cargo short hemmed high with an unfinished raw cut — intentionally so. The leg openings are generously sized and the interior seams are flat-felled to avoid matting fur geneware. The waistband is a wide elastic-and-button hybrid that sits comfortably over a thick fur coat at the hip. Available in khaki, dark olive, and washed navy.
functionality: Wide leg openings and interior flat seams prevent fur compression and matting; elastic waistband accommodates hip fur density variation
what_it_says: You've got fur and you're not going to sweat through tailored trousers on a long shift.
story_hooks: The cargo pockets are deeper than standard — someone has been using them to move small packages through checkpoints that don't look closely at a furry person's shorts.
A character finds a note tucked in the flat seam, sewn in deliberately, from someone who wore these before them.

physical_description.visual_profile: Loose, deliberately unfinished silhouette that reads as intentionally raw and utilitarian. High-hemmed wide legs create an avant-garde asymmetry, slightly cropped mid-thigh with dramatic openings. Pairs visually with layered fur or dense outerwear at the hips.
physical_description.fit: Generously wide through the leg with high-rise positioning designed to sit comfortably over thick base layers or fur geneware. Relaxed at hip and thigh, with openings wide enough to accommodate augmented or modified leg geometry.
physical_description.primary_material: Durable ballistic weave or heavy cotton-synthetic blend, chosen for durability and non-adhesive properties to protect sensitive fur geneware.
physical_description.texture: Raw, exposed stitching at hem creates intentionally distressed aesthetic. Flat-felled interior seams appear smooth to touch to prevent matting delicate fur. Fabric has slight structural rigidity, matte finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three utilitarian palettes: warm khaki, dark olive with possible sun-fade patterning, washed navy with intentional color degradation at seams and edges.
physical_description.closures: Hybrid waistband combining wide elastic band with discrete button fly, designed for easy adjustment over layered clothing without sacrificing visual cohesion.
distinctive_features: Intentionally unfinished raw-cut hem—a design statement, not a flaw
Flat-felled interior seams to prevent fur geneware matting
Generous leg openings suggesting modular augmentation compatibility
High-rise positioning optimized for wearing over substantial base layers
Ovex branding likely subtly placed on waistband or interior
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional wear with aspirational Tier 2 design language; priced as accessible premium for working-class augmentation-positive consumers.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals someone who has invested in quality geneware modifications (fur customization) and values garments engineered specifically for that aesthetic. Popular with modders, animal-gene enthusiasts, sub-med augmentation communities, and GLMZ street culture figures.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but maintained; the unfinished hem intentionally looks raw and will develop fraying and character over time, which enhances rather than detracts from the garment's appeal. Patina develops naturally without becoming damaged.
